displayedInputs.question: Calculate \((-7)+12+(-3)+8\) using a convenient method.
Which property is mainly used in the equality \(13+(-7)+(-13)=13+(-13)+(-7)\)?
Calculate \((-1.6)+3.7+(-2.4)+1.3\) using a convenient method.
Calculate \((-5/2)+(7/3)+(-3/2)+(2/3)\) using a convenient method.
Calculate \(3-(-5)\) and \((-2)-7\). (Give your answers in order, separated by a comma.)
Which of the following expressions has the same value as \(5-(-3)\)?
Calculate \((-3/4)-(5/6)\). Write the result as a fraction in simplest form.
On a certain day in a certain place, the highest temperature was 3 ℃ and the lowest temperature was -9 ℃. What was the temperature difference that day, in ℃?
Which is the correct way to write \(-3+(-5)-(-7)+2\) as a sum with addition signs and parentheses omitted?
Calculate the value of \(1-2+3-4+5-6+\cdots+99-100\).
Calculate \((-3)\times(-4)\) and \((-5)\times2\). (Give your answers in order, separated by a comma.)
Which of the following expressions has a positive result?
Calculate \((-3/4)\times(8/9)\). Write the result as a fraction in simplest form.
When \(a=-3\) and \(b=-4\), find the value of \(ab-a\).
Given \(|a|=3\), \(|b|=5\), and \(ab<0\), find the value of \(ab\).
Use the distributive property to calculate \((-12)\times(1/2-2/3+1/4)\).
What is the product of \((-2)\times3\times(-4)\times(-5)\)?
Calculate \((-2)\times7\times(-5)\).
Calculate \((-5/9)\times13+(-5/9)\times(-4)\).
The product of 5 nonzero rational numbers is positive. Which of the following could be the number of negative factors?
Find the reciprocal of \(-2/5\).
Find the reciprocal of \(-4\).
Which of the following statements is correct?

choices.B: The numbers whose reciprocals equal themselves are 1 and \(-1\).
choices.C: The only number whose reciprocal equals itself is 1.
choices.D: The reciprocal of a number is always less than the number.

displayedInputs.question: Find the reciprocal of \(-1\frac{1}{2}\) (that is, negative one and one-half). Write the result as a fraction.
Given that \(a\) and \(b\) are reciprocals of each other, and \(c\) and \(d\) are additive inverses of each other, find the value of \(4ab-3(c+d)\).
Calculate \((-12)\div(-3/4)\).
Calculate \((-18)\div6\).
Calculate \((-3/8)\div(9/4)\). Write the result as a fraction in simplest form.
Which of the following calculations is correct?
A number multiplied by \(-3/5\) gives 9. What is the number?
Calculate \(-6\div(-2)\times3+(-4)\).
Calculate \(8-12\div(-3)\).
Which of the following is the result of \(2+3\times(-4)\)?
Calculate \((-2)\times(3-5)\div(1/2)-1\).
State the meanings of \((-3)^3\) and \(-3^3\), and calculate them. (Only write the values of the two expressions in the given order, separated by a comma.)
